# Admonitions

Each type of callout, as an author writes them.

<Admonition id="a_note" type="note" title="A note" description="This is a note admonition." />

<Admonition id="an_info" type="info" title="Some info" description="This is an info admonition." />

<Admonition id="a_warning" type="warning" title="A warning" description="This is a warning admonition." closable={true} />

<Admonition id="a_danger" type="danger" title="Danger zone" description="This is a danger admonition." confirmationText="I understand the risks" />

An admonition with no title is headed by its type's name, and markdown
written inside it shows under its description.

<Admonition id="untitled" type="info" description="Billing applies.">
Read the **pricing** page first.

You need:

- The AWS CLI
- OpenTofu v1.6 or later

Then:

1. Sign in.
2. Deploy.
</Admonition>

A long path or URL wraps inside its admonition.

<Admonition id="long_path" type="warning" title="A long path" description="/very/long/path/that/goes/on/and/on/without/any/spaces/to/break/it/at/the/edge/of/the/window/so/it/has/to/wrap/inside/the/box/of/its/admonition/config.yaml" />

An admonition needs no id when nothing refers to it.

<Admonition type="note" description="A note without an id." />
